achievements.name: Pieces of the past

steps: Collect all five Guard of the North armour pieces — helmet, chestplate, gloves, pants and boots — in the Revelwoods around Pikemead's Reach.
Each piece sits at its own marked spot rather than dropping from a boss, so sweep the Reach and its surrounding ruins.

achievements.description: Obtain a ghost glider.

steps: Obtain the Ghost Glider, the legendary glider found at the Sun Temple in the Kindlewastes.
It is a fixed world pickup rather than a craft, so route to the temple and loot it.

achievements.name: Spark of the Springlands
achievements.description: Find all flame shrines and sanctums in the Springlands.

steps: Scale the Ancient Spire in the Springlands and speak to the Flame at the summit — this reveals the region's Flame Sanctums on your map.
Read the region's Ancient Obelisks: each one you read reveals hidden Flame Shrines on your map.
Visit every Flame Shrine and Flame Sanctum in the Springlands and collect the Spark from each.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: players stuck on this one at 56/58 usually find them by comparing their own map markers against a community map rather than by re-exploring — the game keeps no counter for Shrines.
warnings: A Flame site leaves no permanent "collected" mark on the map — a visited and an unvisited Shrine look identical. Mark each one yourself as you go, or you will re-walk sites you already cleared.

achievements.name: Mole of the Springlands
achievements.description: Mine every valuable material in the Springlands.

steps: Mine every valuable material in the Springlands: Flintstone and Salt.
Flintstone sits in the open right around the starting area; Salt comes from the Saline Quarry and Salt Mines, or from mining inside the Shroud.
warnings: Only mining the deposit counts. Taking the same material out of a chest, or looting it from a defeated enemy, does not register it.

achievements.name: Mole of the Revelwoods
achievements.description: Mine every valuable material in the Revelwoods.

steps: Mine every valuable material in the Revelwoods: Lump of Clay, Copper Ore and Amber.
Copper is everywhere in the open; Amber only spawns inside the Shroud, so bring enough time to dig before the timer runs out.
warnings: Only mining the deposit counts. Taking the same material out of a chest, or looting it from a defeated enemy, does not register it.

achievements.name: Mole of the Nomad Highlands
achievements.description: Mine every valuable material in the Nomad Highlands.

steps: Mine every valuable material in the Nomad Highlands: Fossilized Bone and Tin Ore.
Tin Ore and Fossilized Bone both sit near the Nomad Highlands Ancient Spire — Fossilized Bone is the giant fossil skeletons, not ordinary creature bones.
warnings: Only mining the deposit counts. Taking the same material out of a chest, or looting it from a defeated enemy, does not register it.

achievements.name: Mole of the Kindlewastes
achievements.description: Mine every valuable material in the Kindlewastes.

steps: Mine every valuable material in the Kindlewastes: Sandstone, Iron Ore, Sulfur and Lapis Lazuli.
Sulfur and Lapis Lazuli are easiest from the Nomad Highlands side; walk in through the scavenger cave and follow the road into the Shroud.
warnings: Only mining the deposit counts. Taking the same material out of a chest, or looting it from a defeated enemy, does not register it.

achievements.name: Springland weeding
achievements.description: Clear the Springlands of all shroud roots.

steps: Destroy every Shroud Root in the Springlands.
Roots inside Elixir Wells count towards this too — they sit at the bottom of the well, usually behind a mini-boss.
Use an axe on each root; felling one pushes back the local Shroud and drops Shroud materials.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: the achievement tracks the whole regional set, so one Root left unmarked elsewhere in the region keeps it locked even after you clear the obvious ones.
warnings: Patch 1.0 added Shroud Roots to regions that already had them, so a pre-1.0 route or checklist will be short.

The longest material list in the game: a Pearl has to come out of a clam and Mother-of-Pearl from its own deposit, so Gold Ore alone will not finish the gold half.
warnings: Only mining the deposit counts. Taking the same material out of a chest, or looting it from a defeated enemy, does not register it.

warnings: Killing Lord Vorgoth ends the campaign but does not finish the region: any remaining Shrines, Shroud Roots, Obelisks or unmined materials in Cinder's Cradle still need a trip back.
